mapper.select: SELECT part_id AS "partId",part_nm AS "name",hq_yn AS "headquarters",use_yn AS "useYn", reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_bs_part ORDER BY part_nm,part_id

SELECT s.part_id AS "partId",s.aply_bgn_ym AS "month",s.aply_end_ym AS "endMonth", s.part_ldr_user_id AS "leaderId",u.user_nm AS "leaderName",s.prft_dstrb_rt AS "rate",s.sales_exps_amt AS "expense", s.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",s.reg_dttm AS "regDttm",s.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",s.mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_bs_part_std s LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.part_ldr_user_id ORDER BY s.part_id,s.aply_bgn_ym

SELECT trgt_key AS "partId",hist_id::text AS "histId",bfr_val AS "beforeValue",aft_val AS "afterValue",reg_dttm AS "at" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_BS_PART' AND chg_item_nm='USE_YN' ORDER BY reg_dttm,hist_id

SELECT s.part_id AS "partId",s.setl_ym AS "month",s.corp_card_amt AS "cardAmount",s.part_prft_amt AS "partProfitAmount", s.setl_stat_cd AS "status",s.cnfm_user_id AS "confirmedBy",u.user_nm AS "confirmedByName",s.cnfm_dttm AS "confirmedAt", s.cncl_rsn AS "cancellationReason",s.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",s.reg_dttm AS "regDttm",s.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",s.mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_co_part_setl s LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.cnfm_user_id WHERE s.setl_ym=#{month} ORDER BY s.part_id

SELECT d.part_id AS "partId",d.setl_ym AS "month",d.dev_id AS "developerId",p.dev_nm AS "name",p.mng_no AS "managementNo", d.emp_type_cd AS "employeeType",d.proj_nm_list AS "projectText",d.mm AS "mm",d.uprc_amt AS "unitPrice",d.pay_amt AS "pay", d.sales_exps_amt AS "expense",d.retire_amt AS "retirement",d.cost_amt AS "cost",d.diff_amt AS "profit",d.prft_amt AS "share",d.rmrk AS "remark", d.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",d.reg_dttm AS "regDttm",d.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",d.mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_co_part_setl_dtl d LEFT JOIN tb_hr_dev p ON p.dev_id=d.dev_id WHERE d.setl_ym=#{month} ORDER BY d.part_id,d.dev_id
SELECT dev_id AS "developerId",min(input_bgn_dt) AS "date" FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE asgn_stat_cd != 'CNCL' GROUP BY dev_id ORDER BY dev_id

coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY dev_id,aply_bgn_ym),'[]'::jsonb)::text FROM tb_hr_dev_prc t) UNION ALL SELECT 'TB_HR_DEV_STAT',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY
